title: Sanction the reconciliation of the CAD-PARITY-012 post-merge ledger defects

The recording-gap defects (the missing decision record, the missing references, the malformed reference) are repaired in-record by the ledger-completion commit; the two role mis-recordings are immutable audit facts that cannot be lawfully repaired by editing — exactly the already-merged historical-defect shape the ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation pathway (ACR-003/REC-CAD-PARITY-011 precedent) exists for.

impact: A narrowly scoped, audit-preserving reconciliation for CAD-PARITY-012 only: a REC record waiving exactly the two enumerated unauthorized-role violations (transition-legality #9 and #12) under this ACR's sanction, after the ledger-completion commit repairs the recording gaps. No validator rule is weakened, no evidence gate or VERIFIED requirement is waived, the original merge history and all transition audit facts stay verbatim (tamper-evident citations), and the governance test suite's expected-failure assertion keeps enforcing the reconciled state in both directions.

Rewrite the historical merge or edit the recorded roles/timestamps: rejected because it falsifies the immutable audit trail (the same ruling as ACR-003 for CAD-PARITY-011).

Merge P013 over the red governance gate on the theory that the defect predates P013: explicitly rejected by the Architect ('The defect predates P013 does not make a red governance gate acceptable for merging P013').
